data.key: Wave Rider ~ Weapon and Armor Proficiency
data.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
data.description: Wave riders are proficient with all simple and martial weapons and with light and medium armor, but not with shields. This replaces the cavalier's weapon and armor proficiencies.
